mainTopic: Checking the ריאה for טרפות: cysts, the normal five lobes, an extra lobe, and the 'little rose lobe' (עינוניתא דוורדא)
overview: רבא gives two rules about the lung. First, two cysts next to each other make the animal a טרפה. A single cyst that only looks like two is tested by piercing it with a thorn. Second, a healthy lung has five lobes, three on the right and two on the left. רבא says a missing, extra, or switched lobe makes the animal a טרפה. In a story, מרימר rules that the הלכה does not follow רבא about an extra lobe. The גמרא limits this to an extra lobe that sits in line with the others; one in between the sides is a טרפה. Then רב הונא מר בר אויא tells רב אשי that field animals commonly have an in-between 'little rose lobe', which is כשרה, and the גמרא begins to limit that to a lobe on the inside face of the lung.

steps.title: Two cysts side by side, and one cyst that looks like two
steps.stepSummary: רבא rules that two cysts touching each other make the animal a טרפה with no test. One cyst that only looks like two is pierced to check whether the fluid flows between the two sides.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: Two cysts on the lung that sit right next to each other cannot be checked, and the animal is a טרפה. If it is really one cyst that looks like two, we take a thorn and pierce it. If the fluid flows from one side into the other, it is one cyst and the animal is כשרה. If not, they are two cysts and the animal is a טרפה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא gives a rule about fluid-filled cysts on the lung. He explains how to tell one cyst from two.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two separate cysts touching each other cannot be saved by any test, so the animal is a טרפה. A single cyst with a dip in the middle can look like two, so רבא gives a practical test. If the fluid from both sides drains together, there is only one space, and the animal stays כשרה.

keyTerms.meaning: Cysts or blisters (filled with fluid) on the lung
A check or test that could save the animal
An animal with a fatal defect, forbidden to eat even after proper שחיטה

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two cases. 'Two cysts' are truly two and always make the animal a טרפה. 'One that looks like two' is the only case where the thorn test is used.

phrases.english: And Rava said:
These two cysts that are next to each other,
have no checking.
phrases.notes: He means no test can save the animal, so it is a טרפה.

phrases.english: One that looks like two –
we bring a thorn and pierce it,
if they pour into each other –
it is one, and it is kosher,
and if not – they are two, and it is a tereifa.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר רָבָא: הָנֵי תַּרְתֵּי בּוּעֵי דִּסְמִיכָן לַהֲדָדֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a series of רבא's rulings on lung defects from the earlier part of the daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two adjacent cysts make the animal a טרפה. One cyst that looks like two is pierced: if the fluid drains together, the animal is כשרה; if not, it is a טרפה.

steps.title: The normal lung has five lobes
steps.stepSummary: רבא describes a normal ריאה: five lobes, three on the right and two on the left. Any change in this pattern makes the animal a טרפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבא said: The lung has five lobes. When its face is toward the person checking it, there are three on the right and two on the left. If a lobe is missing, if there is an extra one, or if the sides are switched, the animal is a טרפה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא gives a new rule about the normal shape of the lung. He also says what counts as a defect.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This sets the standard: five lobes, three on one side and two on the other. רבא lists three changes from that standard: a missing lobe, an extra lobe, or switched sides. He says each one makes the animal a טרפה, and the next steps will question the 'extra lobe' part.

keyTerms.meaning: Switched (the lobes are on the opposite sides)

steps.whyThisMatters: This count of lobes is the basic picture every בודק uses when checking a lung. The ruling about an extra lobe is about to be challenged.

phrases.english: And Rava said:
The lung has five lobes,
with its face toward the man –
phrases.notes: Picture the animal hanging with its front facing the person who is checking it.

phrases.english: three on the right and two on the left.

phrases.aramaic: חַסִּיר אוֹ יַתִּיר אוֹ חֲלִיף – טְרֵפָה.
phrases.english: Missing, or extra, or switched – it is a tereifa.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר רָבָא: חָמֵשׁ אוּנֵּי אִית לַהּ לְרֵיאָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new, separate ruling of רבא about the lung, moving from cysts to the number of lobes.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A normal lung has five lobes, three on the right and two on the left. A missing, extra, or switched lobe makes the animal a טרפה.

steps.title: A lung with an extra lobe is brought to מרימר
steps.stepSummary: A lung with an extra lobe is brought to מרימר, and he rules it כשרה. רב אחא, sitting at the door, is surprised and sends the owner back in.
steps.simpleTranslation: A lung with an extra lobe was brought before מרימר. רב אחא was sitting at the door. He asked the owner, 'What did he tell you?' The owner said, 'He declared it kosher for me.' רב אחא told him, 'Go back and bring it in before him again!'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tells a story that tests רבא's rule about an extra lobe. It is setting up מרימר's ruling in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Following רבא, an extra lobe should make the animal a טרפה, yet מרימר ruled it כשרה. רב אחא thinks there may be a mistake, so he sends the owner back. This prepares for מרימר's clear answer.

keyTerms.meaning: A lung with an extra lobe

phrases.english: A certain [lung with an] extra [lobe]
that came before Mareimar,
Rav Acha was sitting at the door.
He said to him: What did he tell you?
phrases.notes: רב אחא is asking the owner as he walks out.

phrases.english: He said to him: He declared it kosher for me.
He said to him: Go back and bring it in before him!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A practical case that seems to go against רבא's ruling on an extra lobe.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מרימר declared a lung with an extra lobe כשרה, which surprised רב אחא.

steps.title: מרימר: the הלכה does not follow רבא on an extra lobe
steps.stepSummary: מרימר sends back a message that the הלכה is not like רבא in the case of an extra lobe.
steps.simpleTranslation: מרימר said to the owner: Go tell the one sitting at the door that the הלכה is not like רבא regarding an extra lobe.
steps.whatsHappening: מרימר explains his ruling. On the question of an extra lobe, the הלכה does not follow רבא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא listed three defects: missing, extra, and switched. מרימר rejects only the 'extra' one as practical הלכה. The other two parts of רבא's rule are not touched here.

keyTerms.meaning: The הלכה is not like him

steps.confusionAlert: מרימר does not reject everything רבא said. He only disagrees about an extra lobe. A missing or switched lobe is still a טרפה.

phrases.english: He said to him:
phrases.notes: Now מרימר is speaking to the owner.

phrases.english: Go tell
the one who is sitting at the door,
the halacha is not like Rava regarding an extra [lobe].

steps.triggerLanguage: זִיל אֵימָא לֵיהּ לְמַאן דְּיָתֵיב אַבָּבָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רב אחא's surprise from the story by stating the הלכה.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: For an extra lobe, the הלכה is not like רבא; the animal can be כשרה.

steps.title: The leniency applies only when the extra lobe is in line with the others
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא limits מרימר's leniency. An extra lobe is כשרה only when it sits in the row of the other lobes; if it sits in between the two sides, the animal is a טרפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And this applies only when the extra lobe stands in the row of the other lobes. But if it is in between, the animal is a טרפה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds a limit to מרימר's ruling. Not every extra lobe is allowed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An extra lobe that grows in line with the others, on the right or left side, is כשרה. One that grows in the middle, between the two sides, still makes the animal a טרפה. So the leniency covers only part of the cases.

keyTerms.meaning: And these words apply only... (introduces a limit)
In the row of the lobes

steps.whatToRemember: A missing or switched lobe makes the animal a טרפה. An extra lobe is כשרה if it sits in line with the other lobes, but a טרפה if it sits in between the sides.
steps.whyThisMatters: This limit shapes the practical הלכה for checking lungs with an extra lobe.

phrases.english: And these words apply –
phrases.notes: This refers back to מרימר's leniency about an extra lobe.

phrases.english: when it stands in the row of the lobes,
but [if it is] in between – it is a tereifa.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits the leniency stated by מרימר in the previous step.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An extra lobe is כשרה only when it sits in line with the other lobes. If it sits in between the sides, the animal is a טרפה.

steps.title: An in-between lobe comes before רב אשי
steps.stepSummary: A lung with an extra lobe between the two sides is brought to רב אשי, and he intends to rule it טרפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: There was once a lung with a lobe 'in between' that came before רב אשי. רב אשי thought he would declare it טרפה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tells a real case that matches the rule from step 5, an extra lobe in between the two sides. רב אשי plans to follow that rule, and this sets up the next step, where someone corrects him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 5 said an extra lobe in the row of the other lobes is כשרה, but one in between the two sides is טרפה. רב אשי applies that rule directly. The story is told because the next step will show that one common kind of in-between lobe is actually כשרה.

keyTerms.meaning: In between: an extra lobe sitting between the right and left sides of the lung
He thought / he was inclined to rule

phrases.english: A certain [lung with an extra lobe] in between
that came before Rav Ashi,
Rav Ashi thought to declare it treif.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָהוּא בֵּינֵי בֵּינֵי דַּאֲתָא לְקַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב אָשֵׁי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the step 5 rule (an in-between lobe is טרפה) to a real case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב אשי was inclined to treat an in-between extra lobe as טרפה, following step 5.

steps.title: Field animals commonly have this lobe: the 'little rose lobe'
steps.stepSummary: רב הונא מר בר אויא tells רב אשי that animals grazing outside all have this lobe, and butchers call it the little rose lobe, so it should not be declared טרפה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב הונא מר בר אויא said to him: All these animals that graze outside have it like this, and the butchers call it the little rose lobe.
steps.whatsHappening: רב הונא מר בר אויא stops רב אשי from ruling טרפה. He explains that this lobe is a normal, common feature in field animals.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His point is that something found in many healthy animals is not a defect, so it cannot make an animal טרפה. Butchers even have a name for it, which shows it is a familiar sight. This carves out one known kind of in-between lobe from the step 5 rule.

keyTerms.meaning: Outside animals: animals that graze out in the fields
The 'little rose lobe': the butchers' name for this extra lobe

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the source for the well-known 'ורדא' lobe, an extra lobe that does not make the animal טרפה even though it sits in between.
steps.confusionAlert: This does not cancel the step 5 rule. Most in-between extra lobes are still טרפה; only this specific, common 'rose lobe' is כשרה, and the next step limits even that.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב הוּנָא מָר בַּר אַוְיָא:
phrases.english: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya said to him:
All these animals that graze outside
have it like this,
and the butchers call it
the little rose lobe.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב הוּנָא מָר בַּר אַוְיָא כֹּל הָנֵי חֵיוֵי בָּרָיָיתָא הָכִי אִית לְהוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רב אשי's planned ruling of טרפה for this kind of lobe.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects declaring this specific in-between lobe טרפה, not the step 5 rule as a whole.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רב אשי was treating a common, normal lobe of field animals as a defect.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The 'little rose lobe,' common in field animals, does not make the animal טרפה.

steps.title: The rose lobe is כשרה only on the inside face
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא limits the leniency: the rose lobe is כשרה only when it is on the inside face of the lung, facing the heart.
steps.simpleTranslation: And this applies only when it is on the inside.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts to put a limit on the leniency of the rose lobe. It says the leniency applies only when the lobe is on the inside of the lung, and the sentence continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The words והני מילי signal a limitation on what was just said. Only a rose lobe on the inside face, toward the heart, is כשרה. This prepares the contrast that follows, about a lobe on the outside.

keyTerms.meaning: From the inside: on the inner face of the lung, facing the heart

steps.whatToRemember: An extra lobe in between the two sides is normally טרפה. The common 'rose lobe' (עינוניתא דוורדא) is the exception, but only when it is on the inside face of the lung.

phrases.english: And this applies only on the inside,
phrases.notes: The sentence keeps going on the next amud, which deals with a lobe on the outside.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits the leniency of the rose lobe from step 7 to the inside face of the lung.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The rose lobe is כשרה only when it is on the inside face of the lung, facing the heart.
